episode_id.description: Must equal the current episode ID.

type.description: One of the four documented types (examples). Any other string is structurally valid but never matches (false positive).

affected_ids.description: A set: order and repeats do not matter. Ids are compared exactly (case and whitespace count); a TP needs exactly the issue's set.

claimed_amount_minor.description: Write a JSON integer literal (1234). JSON Schema also counts 1234.0 as an integer, but the environment parses it as a float and rejects the submission (reward -1). A wrong or negative amount is valid but does not match.

currency.description: Compared exactly with the issue currency: no case change, no trimming, no conversion.

evidence_ids.description: At most 10 entries counted before repeats are dropped; then a set. Every id must exist in the episode's public data, else the finding does not match.
